scope: Known-result RP241 diagnostic reanalysis; not preregistration or a new exposure selection
exact_overlap_rule: Drop exact intersecting rsIDs from both analysed directions; no proxy rescue or outcome re-selection
LD_rule: PLINK all union pairs inter-chr; rsID and allele-set concordance to EUR BIM required; compare cross-direction pairs; drop both endpoints at r2>=0.8 in sensitivity
primary_and_sensitivity: Original MR stays primary; exact-excluded and strong-LD-excluded IVW-FE/MRE sensitivities separately report k/F/CI/Q; no winner selection
no_overlap_semantics: Empty exclusion must reproduce original estimator and is labelled identical-set sensitivity, never new replication
Steiger: Record exact EAF/case/control/N/build/proxy provenance first; liability analysis cannot silently borrow counts or frequencies from a different source
grid_interpretation: Illustrative analyst assumptions, not epidemiological prevalence estimates; no liability inference when phenotype/effect fields cannot be matched
public_scope: Candidate preparation only; no automatic push; exclude participant IDs/rows, leave-one person rows and identity lists, private application/DUC, credentials and third-party full-text/raw
preserve: Original full81/43, all effects/P/q, negatives/conflicts/missingness; no new transcriptomic DE or reclassification of historical diagnoses
